interpretation: Chebyshev/Hoeffding intervals are diagnostics only; their validity in this simulation uses known variance/support, neither justified for actual regret yet.
CI coverage is evaluated against the corresponding true mean: 0 under H0, 0.10 under shifted alternative.
Power is rejection of mean zero, separately recorded.
For exactly constant samples, t inference is marked degenerate with point CI; rejection is deterministic and not treated as calibrated inferential evidence.
Near-degenerate finite-variance behavior is numerically fragile and not treated as proof of calibrated inference.
No method is selected as universally valid.
